decimal_encoding: strings; do not compute authoritative quantities on client
unknown_semantics: null means unknown; never zero by coercion

operations.name: integrity_offers_v1
operations.notes: Trusted aggregate applies public eligibility internally. No arbitrary private-offer total lookup. Identical public results for every reader; live only by default.

operations.name: integrity_catalogue_v1
operations.notes: Includes expired, paused, retired and unknown-stock catalogue entries; never substitutes demo offers.

operations.name: integrity_lot_history_v1
operations.notes: UUID keyset page combining provision events and private physical-date assertions. event_id is either record kind; action distinguishes physical_dates_declared/corrected. No actor IDs exposed. Physical correction rows have null quantity.

operations.name: integrity_update_profile_v1
operations.notes: Whitelist only. Audit changes. Location changes disable approved demand-summary access pending review.

operations.name: integrity_set_active_v1
operations.notes: Pause stops new requests and acceptances; existing holders retain access, cancellation and collection where safe.

operations.name: integrity_create_lot_v1
operations.notes: New batch always creates a distinct lot. Physical dates supplied are declarations, never corroboration.

operations.name: integrity_correct_physical_dates_v1
operations.notes: Append attributable correction; preserve previous assertion.

operations.name: integrity_publish_v1
operations.notes: Absolute opening/count command; authenticated declaration and server revision. Reject client actor, channel, strength, verified or feed fields.

operations.name: integrity_reconfirm_v1
operations.notes: Renews availability only. Does not touch physical dates, unit, price or stock.

operations.name: integrity_reconcile_stock_v1
operations.notes: Absolute count replaces balance; never subtract historical movements again. Below held is recorded as shortfall and blocks new commitments.

operations.name: integrity_move_stock_v1
operations.notes: Delta movement in the immutable ledger; one effect per operation. Unit is fixed by lot.

operations.name: integrity_withdraw_v1
operations.notes: Queues notifications for affected holders; no silent hold deletion; safety recall requires independent reviewer route.

operations.name: integrity_request_claim_v1
operations.notes: Freezes exact terms; no reservation until accepted. Only eligible live source/offer/lot.

operations.name: integrity_respond_claim_v1
operations.notes: Accept locks shared stock scope then verifies all current eligibility, server time and frozen terms. Revision includes commitment changes.

operations.name: integrity_collect_claim_v1
operations.notes: Whole claim only. Partial values return PARTIAL_COLLECTION_UNSUPPORTED. Append one delta, transition and outbox in one commit. Retrying cannot deduct twice.

operations.name: integrity_cancel_claim_v1
operations.notes: Claim remains accessible when public offer is hidden, paused or exhausted.

operations.name: integrity_source_cancel_claim_v1
operations.notes: Records source_unfulfillable; releases hold; durable notice. Does not conceal factual shortfall.

operations.name: integrity_my_claims_v1
operations.notes: Own active records first; includes hidden/expired offers; no dependency on public catalogue.

operations.name: integrity_source_claims_v1
operations.notes: Ascending UUID keyset order; current owner/admin/editor/viewer membership required.

operations.name: integrity_operation_v1
operations.auth: original authenticated principal with current action permission
operations.notes: Only own operation metadata. Committed server_time/result is retained for exact command replay. Current role or independent reviewer authority is checked. No private full result returned here.

operations.name: integrity_begin_evidence_v1
operations.notes: Create a stable private attachment record, with current Source role and serialized quota checks. Upload bytes through the Edge endpoint after this commits.

operations.name: integrity_finalize_evidence_v1
operations.notes: UPLOAD_PENDING until validated. Validated image becomes linked and private; PDF becomes quarantined. Same operation/payload returns original result.

operations.name: integrity_publish_evidence_v1
operations.notes: Explicit opt-in: only validated linked image and eligible public Source/offer. Quarantined PDF cannot be published.

operations.name: integrity_withdraw_evidence_v1
operations.notes: Withdraw public access. Fresh anonymous downloads denied; current members may still read sanitized retained bytes.

operations.name: integrity_public_evidence_v1
operations.notes: Returns explicit public eligible validated attachments; never raw Storage paths or actor identifiers.

operations.name: integrity_save_demand_v1
operations.notes: Store approved coarse area, never browser default pin. Reconfirmation maximum 30 days. Interest counts accounts, not households.

operations.name: integrity_demand_summary_v1
operations.auth: independently approved source with fixed review area
operations.notes: Returns CAPABILITY_DISABLED; success schema is reserved and not implemented.

operations.name: integrity_report_v1
operations.notes: A report is an allegation. No automatic credibility penalty.

operations.name: integrity_review_v1
operations.auth: independent assigned reviewer; not member of target source
operations.notes: Audited and permission-checked. Safety block takes precedence over publication and acceptance.

operations.name: integrity_appeal_v1
operations.auth: reporter or authorised affected source admin
operations.notes: Separate reviewer required for appeal decision.

operations.name: integrity_request_business_review_v1
operations.notes: Manual review request, not business verification. Response {review_id,status:"pending"}; internal submitted state is reviewed independently.

operations.name: integrity_activate_legacy_offer_v1
operations.notes: Explicit physical recount and historical-claims acknowledgment. No active legacy claims. Preserves Source/offer identity, historical item units and immutable events; one audited mapping to a new lot, no automatic old-fulfilment deduction.

operations.name: integrity_evidence_status_v1
operations.notes: Current attachment status for reconnect/retry recovery; no signed URL, raw path or submitter identifier.

operations.name: integrity_request_account_closure_v1
operations.notes: Closure commands have their own immutable request/decision IDs and exact response replay; use closure status/queue for current state. Request operation_id is request_id. Independent approval expires after seven days; no policy is legally inferred.

operations.name: integrity_review_account_closure_v1
operations.notes: Closure commands have their own immutable request/decision IDs and exact response replay; use closure status/queue for current state. Request operation_id is request_id. Independent approval expires after seven days; no policy is legally inferred.

operations.name: integrity_account_closure_status_v1
operations.notes: Closure commands have their own immutable request/decision IDs and exact response replay; use closure status/queue for current state. Request operation_id is request_id. Independent approval expires after seven days; no policy is legally inferred.

operations.name: integrity_account_closure_queue_v1
operations.notes: Closure commands have their own immutable request/decision IDs and exact response replay; use closure status/queue for current state. Request operation_id is request_id. Independent approval expires after seven days; no policy is legally inferred.

operations.name: integrity_operator_health_v1
operations.notes: Private aggregate operational issues, durable issue history and five-minute samples. Starter thresholds are warnings, not advertised plan limits or spend caps. No external alert destination is configured.

operations.name: integrity_cancel_account_closure_v1
operations.notes: Requester may withdraw before closure starts. Acquires principal fence and request lock; exact ID/payload replay is stable. Closed accounts cannot regain access.

http_errors.400: VALIDATION_ERROR, bounded-value errors, RATE_LIMITED or CAPABILITY_DISABLED (current staging convention)
http_errors.403: AUTH_REQUIRED, FORBIDDEN or NOT_FOUND; not-found deliberately shares status
http_errors.409: REVISION_CONFLICT, OPERATION_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH, INVALID_TRANSITION, INSUFFICIENT_STOCK or SHORTFALL

write_semantics.fingerprint: SHA-256 of complete PostgreSQL jsonb::text request, including operation_id. Decimal strings are exact: 2 and 2.0 are distinct payloads. JSON object key order is canonicalized by jsonb.
write_semantics.same_payload: Return original committed authorized result including its original server_time; do not infer current stock from a replay
write_semantics.permission_recheck: Current roles checked before command replay; operation lookup checks current authority before returning private operation metadata
locking: Source row FOR SHARE; profile/pause/moderation FOR UPDATE
Current membership row FOR SHARE where role required
Unique operation row insertion and FOR UPDATE
Claim rows FOR UPDATE ordered UUID
write_semantics.commit_visibility: result acknowledges a committed transaction, never a queued stock command
write_semantics.batch: one operation per HTTP call; partial successes acknowledged individually
write_semantics.retry: same operation ID; exponential full jitter 0.5 to 30 seconds, honour Retry-After, stop after six attempts and expose manual retry; role and validation failures are not retryable
write_semantics.version_conflict: do not invent a new expected version or blindly replay; refresh and obtain operator reconciliation
write_semantics.account_closure_fence: Authenticated operations hold shared principal lock before Source locks. Closure takes exclusive principal then relevant Sources in UUID order; stale JWTs resolve to no actor after closure.

expiry_semantics.read_clock: capture one server timestamp per operation/read
expiry_semantics.listing_vs_hold: listing expiry ends new commitments; accepted terms have a separate collection/hold boundary
expiry_semantics.accepted_hold: bounded by frozen collection_end and applicable known safety block; listing expiry alone does not erase holder record
expiry_semantics.public_next_expiry: minimum future listing, collection start/end, accepted hold and known use-by local-midnight boundary
expiry_semantics.durable_worker: one-minute expiry sweep; atomic transition and outbox; read correctness never depends on sweep timeliness
expiry_semantics.realtime: refresh hints only; client foreground/reconnect reconciliation and next-expiry refresh remain required

realtime.payload: global sequence id and timestamp only; no Source, claim, actor or personal data
realtime.client_action: Invalidation hint; refetch safe RPCs. Reconcile on foreground/reconnect and next-expiry timers. Raw Source/current_offer/claim/evidence are not published.
realtime.end_to_end_websocket_test: PASS: actual anonymous and authenticated sockets received identical id/changed_at records; raw private tables absent from publication

evidence_operations.pending_upload_route: POST /functions/v1/integrity-evidence/upload/{attachment_id}; raw bytes; Authorization: Bearer real user JWT, apikey: project publishable key, x-source-id: UUID, Content-Type: declared MIME. Max 10485760 bytes.
evidence_operations.download_route: GET /functions/v1/integrity-evidence/download/{attachment_id}; optional Authorization. Public only when currently eligible, otherwise current Source membership required. Returns sanitized image/png, Cache-Control: no-store. No signed download URL.
evidence_operations.orphan_cleanup: Deployed service-only lease/ack queue and tested worker. Only pending/failed unvalidated private attachments, no validated path, upload window expired plus 72 hours grace. Fixed two paths, permanent upload tombstone, retries/backoff/dead letters. Valid pending, linked and quarantined attachments excluded. Five-minute automatic schedule explicitly approved and enabled.
evidence_operations.states: begin -> pending; successful server byte validation -> uploaded; finalize -> linked for images or quarantined for PDF; explicit public publication; withdrawal removes new public access. Invalid bytes remain private and require a fresh valid attachment when checksum is wrong.
evidence_operations.validation: Pinned magick-wasm 0.0.43 decoder, forced JPEG/PNG/WebP format, metadata stripping and sanitized PNG output. PDF is quarantined, not scanned. Bounded bytes/resources, fixed paths and no overwrites; retained original and sanitized checksums.
evidence_operations.metadata_representation: Evidence media_type/bytes/checksum describe the original declared attachment; gateway download is a separately hashed sanitized PNG. Original bytes are never returned by the user download route.
evidence_operations.revocation_limit: Gateway checks authorization/withdrawal again after reading Storage. A response already in flight or a previously downloaded copy cannot be recalled.

upload_deadlines.authorization: Recheck current membership/closure/cleanup eligibility after decoding and before each Storage write
upload_deadlines.scope: Bounds late requests and rechecks access; does not claim already in-flight Storage requests can be recalled.

notifications.delivery_guarantee: Database notification deduplication; lease tokens fence stale workers; retries/backoff and dead letters. Provider acceptance is not delivery. Actual external delivery remains NOT_RUN.
notifications.worker: Durable service-only leasing/acknowledgement infrastructure deployed; provider adapter/scheduler not configured. Worker core prepared, not deployed. External dispatch remains disabled.

release_blockers: Full logical database backup and isolated database-plus-Storage restore, including erasure tombstones; no managed backups on this Free project
Approved SMTP/provider/sender/DNS/pilot recipients, provider adapter and signed status callback; no real delivery tested
Reviewed retention periods/holds, historical personal-text handling, food-business review and privacy probing; general demand summaries remain disabled
Remaining provider delivery/closure race coverage, external alert destination, contract freeze, frontend cutover and later Production approval
error_handling: RPC business error body is PostgREST {code:"PT400|PT403|PT409",message:<stable business code>,details:null,hint:null}. Gateway errors can use other codes. Error responses do not carry the success envelope or current revision; refresh before reconciliation.

pagination.cursor: last returned UUID; null at end
pagination.consistency: Each page is a fresh transaction. Refresh after changes; no snapshot across pages. Catalogue/claims/history are not active-first.

legacy_compatibility.semantics: Restricted security-definer read returns only public active unexpired safe rows with global held totals and eligibility-gated available_to_claim. No parameters. Prefer paginated integrity_offers_v1.
legacy_compatibility.purpose: Safe legacy reads only; legacy writers remain closed.
legacy_compatibility.activation: integrity_activate_legacy_offer_v1: owner/admin, explicit fresh physical count and historical_claims_reviewed=true, frozen Source/offer ID and slug, new mapped lot, preserved item unit and unknown dates; no historical fulfilment subtraction.
legacy_compatibility.history: Original null-lot events remain unchanged and readable through the mapped lot. Mapping is private and immutable.

moderation_clearance: Independent appeal dismissal clears only that report. Other upheld reports and safety dates continue blocking. Final clearance leaves reservability false until fresh authorized publication. Pre-existing blocks with unknown pre-block state remain conservative.

account_closure.policy: Approved policy must match environment classification. Only synthetic test policy exists. Live file grace minimum 600 seconds is an implementation bound, not a legal retention period.
account_closure.idempotency: Request/decision command replay returns original result; dedicated status returns current state. One active request, three new requests per day. Requester may cancel before preparation; cancellation blocks subsequent approval/work selection.
account_closure.auth_admin_guard: Direct Auth DELETE requires closed principal and bytes_deleted acknowledgement; otherwise ACCOUNT_CLOSURE_REQUIRED. Auth API wraps database failures in its own error format. Soft-deletion deleted_at transition is also guarded; exact SQL error tests pass. Actual API hard-delete tested; soft-delete API lifecycle not run.
account_closure.stale_jwt: Database actor resolves to null once closure commits; normal private RPCs fail AUTH_REQUIRED, even before actual Auth deletion.
account_closure.history: Original event/profile actors and claimants retain same private operational UUID. Pseudonymous retained data, not anonymous.
account_closure.files: Fixed original/sanitized manifest; trusted worker deletes up to four paths per invocation, positively verifies absence and checkpoints each. Auth deletion cannot start until all manifest paths are acknowledged. Replays preserve completion timestamps.
account_closure.remaining: No operator UI or Production operators. Retention/historical-text decisions, upload/delivery races and full erasure-aware restore remain open.
account_closure.operator_workflow: Requester creates/cancels own request; nominated independent erasure operator approves/declines. Reviewer cannot be the target or share Source membership. Approval valid seven days, rechecked before preparation. Only synthetic policy/operators configured.

operations_monitoring.auth: nominated monitor operator only, not ordinary Source owner/admin
operations_monitoring.scan: every five minutes; expiry every minute

warning_thresholds.meaning: Starter operational warnings; not billing limits or spend caps.

operations_monitoring.catalog_boundary: Private parameterless postgres-owned read-only helper returns the fixed expiry job health boolean because cron catalog RLS hides its rows from the restricted application role.
